perks.name: Elemental Capacitor
perks.desc:
Increased stats based on the currently equipped Super.
• [Solar] increases your reload speed.
• [Arc] increases handling.
• [Void] increases stability.
• [Stasis] moderately controls recoil and increases movement speed when aiming down sights.
• [Strand] increases airborne effectiveness.

perks.name: Killing Wind
perks.desc: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

perks.name: Perpetual Motion
perks.desc: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion.

perks.name: Steady Hands
perks.desc: Kills provide improved handling for all weapons for a short duration.

perks.name: Stats for All
perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases weapon handling, stability, reload, and range for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Well-Rounded
perks.desc:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants a stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.

perks.name: Rimestealer
perks.desc: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you Frost Armor.

perks.name: Lone Wolf
perks.desc: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

perks.name: Under Pressure
perks.desc: Improved stability and accuracy as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Eye of the Storm
perks.desc: This weapon becomes more accurate and boosts handling as your health gets lower.

perks.name: Envious Arsenal
perks.desc: Dealing damage with both other weapons before readying this weapon refills it from reserves.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.desc: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

perks.name: Harmony
perks.desc: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for a short duration.

perks.name: High-Impact Reserves
perks.desc: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

perks.name: Chill Clip
perks.desc: Direct hits with the top half of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.

perks.name: Swashbuckler
perks.desc: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon.

perks.name: Vorpal Weapon
perks.desc: Increased damage against bosses, vehicles, and Guardians with their Super active.

perks.name: Successful Warm-Up
perks.desc: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

perks.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
perks.desc: Rapid final blows spawn a [Stasis] Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

perks.name: Closing Time
perks.desc: Improves range, accuracy, and handling as the magazine gets lower.

perks.name: Kickstart
perks.desc: Gain bonus damage and charge rate during a slide after sprinting for a short duration.

perks.name: Controlled Burst
perks.desc: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for a short duration.

perks.name: Aggregate Charge
perks.desc: This weapon deals more damage for each elemental debuff applied to the target.

perks.name: Alacrity
perks.desc: Gain increased reload, stability, aim assist, and range when an ally is defeated. Bonus increases when multiple allies are dead at the same time or when you are running solo.

perks.name: One Quiet Moment
perks.desc: Grants increased reload speed and handling when out of combat. Swords gain faster movement speed.

perks.name: Fleet Footed
perks.desc: Dealing damage grants you a short window of increased movement speed and airborne effectiveness. Landing a final blow increases these effects.

perks.name: Roar of Battle
perks.desc: Being in combat for a short duration increases handling and stability.

notes: Inspired by @ImpetusAlways, @Saint_Kabr and @CourtProjects (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing bulkier minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with Stasis builds. Burden of Guild is an adaptive frame fusion rifle, which are rated C-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic tiering spreadsheet https://linktr.ee/TheAegisRelic. The stats are good by comparison with its peers, which are helped at Tier 4/5 when barrel and magazine perks are enhanced - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/976459525 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. From the @Mossy-Max spreadsheet at https://www.destiny2.science/ base Magazine size is 6 (max 8) and total ammo is 19 (max 22). Recoil Direction of 55 is vertical but loose, so Arrowhead Brake is a clear top choice for the barrel perk, but any Handling boost is good. In the battery slot, Enhanced Battery bumps the total number of charges without any malus. For Stasis synergy, in the first trait perk column there's Rimestealer, which generates a stack (2 stacks when enhanced) of Frost Armor on shattering a Stasis crystal or killing a frozen enemy - improved further with Whisper of Rime. In the second column, pair this with Crystalline Corpsebloom which procs on a kill to provide a 4s buff - kills with the buff active generate a stasis seeker which travels 3m and spawns a medium Stasis crystal (large when enhanced) to shatter for AoE damage and proc subclass fragment effects. For the Origin Trait, there's either Roar of Battle to grant a nice, if unspectacular +10 Stability and Handling for a refreshable 6s after dealing or taking damage every 0.5s or so for 2s, but that's still better than Fleet Footed, which is more aimed at PvP, as it improves movement speed and Airborne Effectiveness for a refreshable 6s after dealing damage, with improved boosts on a kill. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.

It's hard to compete with Riptide's Auto-Loading/Chill Clip combination, but Burden of Guilt does a good job finding itself high-Handling options." tags:pve

pandapaxxy (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "Adaptive frames have almost always been in the shadow of precisions and they are always grouped into the same “frame” changes. For PvE, similar to other fusions, vorpal weapon is the best in slot perk to look for. Perpetual motion is the best reload perk, which you will need with the low 31 reload stat." Recommended MW - Reload.

pandapaxxy (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "PvP is where I think Burden of Guilt will be able to really show its metaphorical stuff. Having both elemental capacitor to max out handling, or stability, or increase your strafe speed; and high-impact reserves to make the damage profile similar to precisions is incredibly strong." Recommended MW - Stability.

Inspired by DMB Player Versus Enemies Podcast 20. PvE first-choice roll for end-game crowd control, majors and burst damage. The Alacrity origin trait stat boosts make this excellent for soloing content. Arrowhead Brake helps with controlling the burst, and Enhanced Battery takes the mag size to seven, or Accelerated Coils increases burst damage potential. Unusually, Elemental Capacitor rolls in the first trait column giving huge stat boosts depending on your subclass, and Chill Clip is great for crowd control. Recommended MW: Handling or Reload Speed, with a Backup Mag or damage-boosting (Major, Boss or Taken Spec) mod.
